caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a three-dimensional squirrel figurine positioned centrally on a light, cream-colored background. The squirrel is perched on a circular base colored in shades of muted olive and brown. The squirrel itself is rendered in brown tones with various highlights and shading to give a sense of volume and texture. It has a prominent, upright bushy tail that also features brown and yellowish gradients. The figurine is shown holding a reddish-brown object, possibly a nut, in its forepaws near its mouth. The squirrel's facial features, such as the eyes, nose, and mouth, are outlined with red lines, and there are additional red accents above the eyes and around the mouth. The drawing has no other objects or patterns, and the background remains unadorned.
title: Squirrel
